sections.agencyDescription: Shows on client reports, submissions and invoices.
sections.recruitmentDefaultsDescription: Applied to every new client and requisition. Both can override per record.
sections.formatsDescription: How every record is numbered. Quote these in emails, invoices and client conversations.
sections.brandColourDescription: Applied to buttons, links and the client portal header. Contrast is checked against white before it can be saved.
sections.reportBrandingDescription: How reports, digests & submissions look to clients
sections.languageDescription: The default for everyone here. Individuals can override it in their own profile.
sections.regionalFormatsDescription: Applied to every date, number and amount the product renders. Preset from your language, override any of them.
sections.workingTimeDescription: SLA clocks, interview slots and automated reminders all run against this — an overdue counter does not tick over a weekend.
sections.addressesDescription: Where automated mail comes from, and where replies land.
sections.signatureDescription: Appended to every email HirePilotX sends on your behalf.
